notes.title: Early access and future
notes.content:
Hi everyone !

This is the day... The early access is out !
Thanks to all curators that helped us with their feedbacks.

So, what's next in the future ?
We will continue to update the game, upgrade musics, upgrade visuals, add features and more cards.
We have many many ideas based on feedbacks.
You can follow the roadmap of the game here : https://trello.com/b/wA4VGtTO/survival-draw-roadmap
And of course send us your feedback trough early access community page ;)

Have fun and see you soon !

BovinoSoftware.
